## Acceptance criteria {.smaller}

A case passes only if all four hold:

1. accuracy is assessed on an **independent test set**, not the one used for tuning
2. error is in **engineering terms** — MaxAE as % of yield strength (or allowable deflection), not only R²
3. model behaviour **outside the domain of applicability** is shown
4. the **model passport** is complete: domain, data volume and source, accuracy, package versions

::: {.muted}
A formal R² = 0.99 without these points is not an acceptance.
:::
